notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Squirrels.
description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding six {C}
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
